capabilities.scope: Conjugate heat transfer between multiple fluid and solid regions on defined paired interfaces. Fluid p and p_rgh are in Pa; T is in K. This profile selects turbulentTemperatureCoupledBaffleMixed on the paired heat-transfer patches. The mixed boundary receives neighbor internal temperature and neighbor conductance weights in both directions, then derives the signed heat flux locally.

capabilities.scope: v2606 signed face-weighted thermal readback: X_b=Σ(mdot_f X_f)/Σmdot_f, face mdot includes area. Scalar integrated mass phi uses weightedAverage; weightedAreaAverage multiplies area again. Vector mass flux density uses area-weighted normal projection. Check actual phi dimensions: compressible buoyantSimpleFoam mass flux; incompressible phi may be volumetric, requiring face density to obtain mass flow. Signed net mean includes reverse flow and is ill-conditioned near zero net flow; only-outflow requires selecting positive faces, not absolute weighting. Variable cp requires mass-weighted enthalpy and thermodynamic inversion to temperature at a declared state. Wall mode tokens are flux, power and coefficient, not internal enum fixedHeatFlux. This record describes versioned operations, not an automatic validated mixed-cup implementation.
